title: Rolling-window legend summarization + ARIA live-context for streaming time-series
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Problem: High-density streaming charts produce noisy, frequently updating legends and tooltips. Screen reader users get flooded when every datapoint causes an announcement; developers see CPU spikes when the legend re-renders each tick. Goal: design a compact rolling-window legend that summarizes live time-series (last N seconds/minutes) with configurable aggregation buckets, while providing a single concise ARIA context update that conveys meaningful changes without spamming assistive tech. Also propose performance-friendly rendering strategies so the component stays within our latency/CPU SLOs for realtime dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: UI: New legend can display a rolling summary for each series with these aggregates: last, min, max, p50 (median), and sample-count over the configured window
AX: Screen readers receive a single summary update when the visible summary changes materially (threshold-based) rather than for every datapoint
Perf: Legend DOM updates amortized do not exceed 5% CPU delta on a 1000-series synthetic load compared to baseline component
API: Legend component exposes props for windowLength, bucketSize, aggregationFunctions, ariaAnnouncementThreshold and streamingMode: [sparse|windowed|snapshot]
Dev: Design tokens and visual specs are added to the charting design system (colors, condensed typography, density tokens)
Docs: Confluence spec and example storybook story with knobs for window length and accessibility demo

comments: 2026-03-01 - Evelyn Chen: Initial triage and problem statement documented. Flagging existing ENG-20444 (streaming kernels) as dependency because runtime aggregation should reuse the same sampling hooks.

2026-03-03 - Marco Ruiz: Drafted two compact layout directions: inline condensed table vs stacked pill summaries. Prefer inline for high-density dashboards; stacked for touch surfaces. Uploaded mock PNG: https://drive.redwood.com/rolling-legend/mock_v1.png

2026-03-05 - Aisha Patel (a11y): Accessibility note — avoid aria-live='assertive'. Recommend aria-live='polite' with role='status' and batching updates every 1s or on threshold. Suggest announcing changes only when last changes by >5% or count changes by >10%.

2026-03-07 - Marco Ruiz: Eng spike complete. Prototype uses a WebWorker aggregator that computes bucketed aggregates and posts summary diffs to main thread. Reduced main-thread diff ops by ~78% in local synthetic test (100 series, 10Hz). PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3821

2026-03-09 - Design & Eng sync: Decision: implement two-level legend — condensed inline row with hover-to-expand; default shows last/min/max/p50. Add 'summarize' API for developers to choose alternative aggregates (mean, p90). Add ariaAnnouncementThreshold as prop. Plan: ship behind feature flag 'rolling-legend-v1'.

2026-03-12 - UX copy review: Finalize sample announcement template: '{seriesName}: last {lastValue}, min {minValue}, max {maxValue}, median {p50}, {count} samples in last {window}s.' Ensure numeric formatting uses locale tokens from design system.
2026-03-12 - QA note: Need regression test for tooltip integrity when legend aggregates are active and when series are toggled off. Also add perf benchmark in CI for 500-series load.
